name: Crown of the Earth
summary: Near Starbreeze Village, you draw sacred water for Darnassus. Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar asks young night elves to replenish the city's moonwell, and the work teaches the history behind their care for Teldrassil's great boughs.

sections.title: Sustaining the Moonwells
sections.body: You carry a jade phial made by druids to Starbreeze Village, where a lesser moonwell holds sanctified water. Its refined craft lets you draw and carry the luminous water without disturbing its purity. Darnassus's central moonwell depends on these scattered fonts, and the elders send initiates on foot so the city's fountains stay full of Elune's grace. The journey also teaches the young what it takes to nourish Teldrassil.

sections.title: Echoes of the Third War
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage tells you of the sorrow that followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. The sacrifice of Nordrassil, the ancestral World Tree, cost the night elves their immortality. Illidan Stormrage was unleashed amid the ruin, while Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared. Grief and isolation marked the days that followed, as the kaldorei turned to Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the purpose of drawing moonwell water?
faq.answer: Druids in Darnassus replenish the city's main moonwell with water from forest shrines, sustaining the sacred network across Teldrassil.

faq.q: Where is the moonwell for this task located?
faq.answer: The moonwell lies just outside Starbreeze Village, east of Dolanaar along the forest path.
Corithras Moonrage is a night elf in Dolanaar who guides young adventurers through ritual duties and teaches the histories tied to Teldrassil's health.

faq.q: What history does Corithras teach upon return?
aliases: crown of the earth lore text
faq.answer: Corithras recounts the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal: Nordrassil was sacrificed, kaldorei immortality ended, Illidan was unleashed, and Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared.

faq.q: Why do night elves feel lost after Mount Hyjal?
faq.answer: Nordrassil gave the night elves perpetual life and protection. They sacrificed its power to destroy Archimonde, losing their timeless existence and becoming mortal, directionless, and deeply vulnerable.
Shan'do means “honored teacher” in Darnassian. It is an honorific for Malfurion Stormrage, the druids' supreme leader.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face the loss of immortality and the disappearance of Malfurion Stormrage. Drawing moonwell water is an essential lesson in your people's recent grief.
As a druid, you know the moonwells as living reservoirs of nature and astral magic. Their waters bind your order's duties in Darnassus to Teldrassil's roots.
